mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_rejections (post_id, reason, rejected_by, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{reason}, #{rejectedBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM post_rejections WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT pr.id, pr.post_id, pr.reason, pr.rejected_by, pr.created_at, m.username AS rejector_name FROM post_rejections pr LEFT JOIN members m ON pr.rejected_by = m.id WHERE pr.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
